reason: Both parts are accurate. ensure_loaded! (lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:62-65) repeats the `@loaded_locales.include?` check that load_locale already does inside its mutex (line 48). It also guards with `@loaded_locales ||= []` (line 63), while translate reads `@loaded_locales` directly at line 68, and the only other place that sets it is reload! (line 40). The repeated check is the same lock-free fast path translate uses, so this is a style inconsistency, not a bug.
